# Contributing to Praxist

The canonical contribution workflow is maintained in
[`docs/guides/contributing.md`](https://github.com/sapientinc/PRAXIST/blob/main/docs/guides/contributing.md). Read it together
with [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before changing code, tests, documentation,
templates, examples, or skills.

Use GitHub issues for reproducible defects and scoped proposals. Keep pull
requests focused, add verification at the affected boundary, and do not include
credentials, private task data, research-run artifacts, or unrelated generated
files.

By submitting a contribution, you represent that you have the right to submit
it and agree that it is governed by [`LICENSE.md`](../LICENSE.md), including the
contribution terms in Section 1.6. Praxist is source-available under a non-OSI
Fair Source license; contributing does not change that license classification.

Community conduct is defined in [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
Report security vulnerabilities privately to praxist@sapient.inc.
